name: Foundational Ball Control & Finishing
objective: Develop adaptable dribble control and master finishing through contact and in chaotic situations.

drills.name: Off-Hand Freestyle
drills.description: Dribble continuously with your weak hand, using any moves you want. Stay low and keep your eyes up.

drills.name: Over-Line Pulls
drills.description: Place the ball over a line on the court, then quickly pull it back with a sharp in-and-out or crossover move. Alternate hands.

drills.name: Net Tap Finishes
drills.description: Start under the rim. Jump up and tap the net with the ball before finishing a layup. Helps with body control and finishing high. Alternate sides.

drills.name: Body-Touch Finishing
drills.description: Drive from the wing. As you gather for the layup, touch the ball to your hip or shoulder to protect it from defenders before finishing.

drills.name: The Finisher's Gauntlet
drills.description: Make 20 layups from various angles around the hoop as quickly as you can. The clock stops when you hit 20 makes.

name: TJL Advanced Ball Handling & Finishing
objective: A 40-minute workout to improve ball control, finishing, and shooting off the dribble.

drills.name: Freestyle Warmup
drills.description: 5 minutes of free-form dribbling to warm up.

drills.name: Cross Pullback Series
drills.description: Cross pullback (down and back), then between the legs, then behind the back.

drills.name: Outside the Feet Dribbling
drills.description: Dribble outside the feet without carrying. Right hand down and back, then left hand down and back.

drills.name: Freestyle Pullback & Protect
drills.description: Freestyle dribbling, then a quick pullback and protect the ball.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (Cross, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right side, cross over, get to the left lane line, cross back, and finish.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (BTL, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right side, go between the legs, get to the left lane line, go between the legs again, and finish.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (BTB, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right side, go behind the back, get to the left lane line, go behind the back again, and finish.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (Cross, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left side, cross over, get to the right lane line, cross back, and finish.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (BTL, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left side, go between the legs, get to the right lane line, go between the legs again, and finish.

drills.name: Side to Side Finishes (BTB, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left side, go behind the back, get to the right lane line, go behind the back again, and finish.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (Cross, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right elbow, cross over to the left elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (BTL, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right elbow, go between the legs to the left elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (BTB, Right)
drills.description: Start on the right elbow, go behind the back to the left elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (Cross, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left elbow, cross over to the right elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (BTL, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left elbow, go between the legs to the right elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: Elbow Pull-ups (BTB, Left)
drills.description: Start on the left elbow, go behind the back to the right elbow in one dribble, and pull up for a shot.

drills.name: 3-Combo Move Finishes Left
drills.description: 3 combo move on the 3pt wing (ex. cross, BTL, cross), then get downhill and finish. Different finish and tempo each time, same combo move each time.

drills.name: 3-Combo Move Finishes Right
drills.description: 3 combo move on the 3pt wing (ex. cross, BTL, cross), then get downhill and finish. Different finish and tempo each time, same combo move each time.

drills.name: Crossover Pull-ups left to right
drills.description: Left to right pull up. Sell the drive, then create space.

drills.name: Crossover Pull-ups right to left
drills.description: Right to left pull up. Sell the drive, then create space.

drills.name: 3-Combo Move to pull up 3. Left-hand start
drills.description: 3 combo move on the 3pt wing (ex. cross, BTL, cross), then pull up from 3. Start with left hand.

drills.name: 3-Combo Move to pull up 3. Right-hand start
drills.description: 3 combo move on the 3pt wing (ex. cross, BTL, cross), then pull up from 3. Start with right hand.
